title: Salvation Lies Within: Eliciting Inherent Style Transfer in Step-Distilled Diffusion Models
title_zh: 救赎源于内在：在步蒸馏扩散模型中激发固有风格迁移

paragraphs.en: Adapting step-distilled text-to-image (T2I) models through post-training incurs additional computational costs and affects native few-step generation behavior. This motivates a complementary route beyond style-specific adaptation: drawing on the visual knowledge already encoded in step-distilled T2I models to elicit stylistic capabilities through language. Pursuing this direction requires textual guidance that captures how visual attributes jointly define a style and remain applicable as the depicted content changes. To explore this approach, we introduce StyleForge, a fully automatic, training-free framework that expresses reference styles as reusable rendering instructions. By integrating overall rendering characteristics with local color and lighting behavior, StyleForge organizes visual evidence from reference images into a coherent specification of how the target style should be expressed. The specification is then compiled into textual guidance that can be reused across content prompts, enabling frozen step-distilled T2I models to render different subjects and scenes in the reference style while retaining native few-step generation. Extensive experiments show relative gains of up to 29.47% in generation quality scores over the strongest baseline, while Pareto analysis indicates that improved stylization is accompanied by strong adherence to the requested content.
paragraphs.zh: 通过训练后调整步骤蒸馏文本到图像（T2I）模型会产生额外的计算成本，并影响其原生少步生成行为。 这促使我们探索一种超越特定风格适应的补充方法：利用步骤蒸馏 T2I 模型中已编码的视觉知识，通过语言激发其风格表现能力。 要推进这一方向，需要能够捕捉视觉属性如何共同定义某种风格，并在描绘内容变化时保持适用的文本引导。 为探索这一方法，我们提出了 StyleForge——一个完全自动化且无需训练的框架，它将参考风格表示为可重用的渲染指令。 通过将整体渲染特征与局部颜色和光照行为相结合，StyleForge 将参考图像中的视觉证据组织成一份连贯的规范，明确目标风格的表达方式。 该规范随后被编译为文本引导，可在不同内容提示中重复使用，使固定的步骤蒸馏 T2I 模型能够以参考风格呈现不同的主体和场景，同时保留其原生少步生成能力。 大量实验表明，与最强的基线模型相比，生成质量得分最高提升了 29.47%；而帕累托分析显示，在增强风格化的同时，模型仍能严格遵循所要求的内容。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have advanced rapidly ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2024 ) , enabling a wide range of applications in digital art ( Gao et al., 2025 ) , graphic design ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and visual content creation ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) . However, conventional diffusion models typically require many sequential denoising evaluations, leading to high computational costs and inference latency. To make generation more efficient ( Sun et al., 2025a ; Sun et al., 2026a ) , step-distillation techniques have emerged ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Ge et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2025b ; Luo et al., 2025 ) , enabling high-quality synthesis in only a few denoising steps ( Saharia et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型取得了飞速发展（Yang 等，2022；Cao 等，2024），使其在数字艺术（Gao 等，2025）、平面设计（Wang 等，2025）和视觉内容创作（Brooks 等，2023）等领域得到了广泛应用。 然而，传统的扩散模型通常需要多次顺序的去噪评估，导致计算成本高昂且推理延迟较高。 为了提高生成效率（Sun 等，2025a；Sun 等，2026a），步长蒸馏技术应运而生（Lin 等，2024；Ge 等，2026；Sun 等，2025b；Luo 等，2025），使得仅通过少数几次去噪步骤即可生成高质量图像（Saharia 等，2022）。

paragraphs.en: Among the applications of step-distilled T2I models, style transfer is particularly demanding, for it requires a model to preserve the rendering characteristics of a reference while synthesizing new semantic content. Classical style transfer methods restyle a given content image through feature-statistics alignment or adaptive feature transformation ( Gatys et al., 2016 ; Huang and Belongie, 2017 ) . Recent style transfer approaches shift the focus from restyling existing images to synthesizing new subjects and scenes in a reference style with T2I models through learnable style representations ( Sohn et al., 2023 ; Hertz et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . However, in the few-step setting, adapting these models to new styles requires preserving the generation behavior learned during distillation. Prior work has shown that conventional post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), can disrupt this behavior and produce blurry outputs ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) , motivating training strategies tailored to this setting. A representative effort in this direction is D-OPSD ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) , which uses on-policy self-distillation to learn new styles while retaining few-step generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在步数蒸馏 T2I 模型的应用中，风格迁移尤其具有挑战性，因为它要求模型在合成新的语义内容时，同时保留参考图像的表现特征。 传统的风格迁移方法通过特征统计对齐或自适应特征变换（Gatys 等，2016；Huang 和 Belongie，2017）来重新定义给定内容图像的风格。 近期的风格迁移方法将重点从重新定义现有图像的风格转向利用 T2I 模型，通过可学习的风格表示以参考风格合成新的主体和场景（Sohn 等，2023；Hertz 等，2024；Wang 等，2024）。 然而，在少步设置中，将这些模型适应新风格需要保留蒸馏过程中学到的生成行为。 先前的研究表明，传统的训练后方法（如监督微调（SFT））可能会破坏这种生成行为并产生模糊的输出（Jiang 等，2026a），这促使人们开发针对该设置的专门训练策略。 这一方向上的一个代表性工作是 D-OPSD（Jiang 等，2026a），它通过在线策略自蒸馏学习新风格，同时保留少步生成的质量。

paragraphs.en: Despite recent progress, such adaptation-based approaches still incur additional training costs, and adaptation remains a delicate process that can compromise the model’s original few-step generation capability ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) . These limitations raise a natural question: Can the inherent capabilities of step-distilled T2I models be elicited for style transfer? This possibility is motivated by the remarkably broad visual vocabulary that modern step-distilled T2I models already command. Even simple textual descriptions can evoke recognizable stylistic characteristics, suggesting that the capabilities needed for style transfer may already exist within step-distilled models. The challenge is therefore to identify transferable style information and organize it into textual guidance that elicits the intended style across different subjects and scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管最近取得了进展，这类基于适应的方法仍然会产生额外的训练成本，而且适应过程本身十分微妙，可能会损害模型原有的几步生成能力（Jiang 等人，2026a）。 这些局限性引出了一个自然的问题：能否激发步骤蒸馏 T2I 模型与生俱来的能力，用于风格迁移？ 这种可能性源于现代步骤蒸馏 T2I 模型已经掌握的极为丰富的视觉词汇。 即使是简单的文本描述也能唤起可识别的风格特征，这表明进行风格迁移所需的能力可能已经存在于步骤蒸馏模型之中。 因此，挑战在于识别可迁移的风格信息，并将其组织成文本引导，从而在不同主体和场景中激发预期的风格。

paragraphs.en: Visual style is characterized by recurring rendering attributes and the relationships that organize them into a coherent appearance. Successful style transfer requires both fidelity to these characteristics in the reference and adherence to the content specified by the target prompt. Meeting both requirements through textual guidance presents three challenges: (i) Style descriptions may conflate reusable rendering attributes with subjects and layout, introducing unwanted content constraints in new scenes. (ii) Hue (e.g., red or blue) alone does not specify a color’s visual role or spatial extent: the same hue may cover a broad material region or appear as a local luminous accent. (iii) Independently listed visual attributes can leave local surface and color details disconnected from the overall rendering manner, resulting in fragmented guidance for the step-distilled T2I model.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉风格的特点在于重复出现的渲染属性，以及将这些属性组织成连贯外观的关系。 成功的风格迁移既需要忠实于参考样式中的这些特征，也需要遵循目标提示所指定的内容。 通过文本引导同时满足这两项要求存在三个挑战：(i) 风格描述可能将可重用的渲染属性与主体和布局混为一谈，从而在新场景中引入不必要的内容限制。 (ii) 仅凭色调（例如红色或蓝色）无法确定颜色的视觉作用或空间范围：相同的色调可能覆盖一个广阔的材料区域，也可能表现为局部的高光点缀。 (iii) 独立列出的视觉属性可能导致局部表面和颜色细节与整体渲染方式脱节，从而为分步蒸馏的 T2I 模型提供碎片化的指导。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose StyleForge , a fully automatic framework that enables style transfer by eliciting the inherent capabilities of step-distilled T2I models. The framework organizes visual attributes into a structured style state according to their transfer behavior, specifying which information should be preserved, weakened, or excluded when content changes. Within this state, color and light are specified jointly with their visual roles, transferable surface types, spatial extent, and distribution. The state is then compiled into textual guidance that places local surface and color attributes within the overall rendering manner. The resulting style prompt can be combined with different content prompts to guide the frozen step-distilled T2I model in rendering new content in the specified style. paragraphs.en: Diffusion-Based Image Generation . Diffusion-based T2I generation has progressed from latent-space denoising ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) to scalable multimodal rectified-flow transformers ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , improving image fidelity and prompt following. Alongside these quality improvements, inference efficiency has become an important goal for practical deployment, as also reflected in recent commercial models ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . Step distillation addresses this need by enabling image generation in one or a few sampling steps. Representative methods learn consistent mappings along sampling trajectories ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ; Song et al., 2023 ; Luo et al., 2023 ) , match generated and target distributions ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) , or incorporate adversarial objectives ( Sauer et al., 2023 ) . More recent work refines distribution matching through Decoupled-DMD ( Liu et al., 2025 ) and integrates distillation with reinforcement learning in DMDR ( Jiang et al., 2026b ) . Recent model releases further demonstrate the practical viability of few-step synthesis: the distilled FLUX.2 [klein] 4B and 9B variants ( Black Forest Labs, 2026 ) support image generation and editing in four steps, while Z-Image-Turbo ( Z-Image Team et al., 2025 ) combines a compact 6B backbone with eight-step generation. Their low sampling budgets make interactive content creation and deployment on consumer hardware increasingly practical. We therefore focus on step-distilled T2I models, whose strong visual capabilities and low sampling cost favor widespread adoption.

paragraphs.en: Style Transfer . Early style transfer relies on feature-statistic matching ( Gatys et al., 2016 ; Huang and Belongie, 2017 ; He et al., 2024 ) . With pretrained T2I models, reference-based customization becomes possible through fine-tuning, as exemplified by DreamBooth for subject-driven generation ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ) . Further work on style learning and reference-guided generation can be found in Gal et al. (2022) ; Sohn et al. (2023) ; Hertz et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) ; Sun et al. (2026b) . However, extending style adaptation to step-distilled generators introduces an additional constraint: learning the target style must preserve the generation behavior acquired during distillation. Conventional denoising or flow-matching fine-tuning optimizes states derived from noised target images, which can differ from those visited by the model’s few-step sampler; this mismatch can disrupt the distilled behavior and produce blurry outputs ( Miao et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026a ) . To address this issue, PSO ( Miao et al., 2025 ) uses pairwise sample optimization to directly tune timestep-distilled models. D-OPSD ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) adopts on-policy self-distillation, using a teacher with richer multimodal conditioning to supervise the student’s own sampling trajectories and learn new styles while retaining few-step generation quality. These methods enable style adaptation in the few-step regime through additional training. StyleForge explores a complementary approach by converting reference images into reusable textual rendering instructions that elicit the frozen generator’s existing style capabilities while preserving its native few-step sampling procedure.

paragraphs.en: One established line of work approaches style transfer through post-training. Related work, such as D-OPSD ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) , adapts model parameters to a given reference style, maintaining a style-specific learned state. Such adaptation incurs additional training costs for each target style and may disrupt the model’s distilled generation behavior, degrading few-step image quality. This motivates a central question: can style transfer be achieved without per-style post-training? Our key insight is that modern step-distilled diffusion models already possess broad visual priors that can be elicited through precise textual descriptions of rendering attributes. Figure 1 illustrates two aspects of this control. In (a), the requested blue and yellow colors appear on the robot’s body and scarf, respectively. In (b), the phrases “mostly” and “a small bottom layer” yield a dominant cyan region above a thin magenta layer in the glass. These examples suggest that textual instructions can specify visual attributes together with the surfaces they apply to, their relative extent, and their spatial arrangement. This motivates expressing style as a structured specification of rendering behavior.

paragraphs.en: Structured extraction (reference image set ℛ \mathcal{R} → \rightarrow structured style evidence). To make visual observations computable and checkable, the visual style agent invokes the multimodal model Φ \Phi with the reference-image parsing protocol q q to analyze ℛ \mathcal{R} . Protocol q q instructs the model to extract rendering practices shared across the images, together with colors and their carriers. The protocol also instructs the model to record subjects, props, and scenes that must not be transferred. Based on the extracted information, the model outputs style evidence in a structured format (e.g., JSON), organized into four categories: rendering M ℛ M_{\mathcal{R}} , color and light A ℛ A_{\mathcal{R}} , composition T ℛ T_{\mathcal{R}} , and reference content L ℛ L_{\mathcal{R}} . To ensure structural validity and prevent reference-content leakage, the agent validates the evidence before passing it to subsequent modules. All required fields must be present, and each color record must include both a color and its carrier surface. Rendering descriptions must exclude reference subjects, props, and scenes.

paragraphs.en: Prompt compilation (style state S ℛ S_{\mathcal{R}} → \rightarrow style prompt p ℛ p_{\mathcal{R}} ). paragraphs.en: We evaluate StyleForge on MegaStyle-1.4M ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , a diverse testbed for style transfer. For efficiency, we randomly sample 31 style categories and generate 16 scenes per category for each method, averaging metrics over these scenes. We instantiate the few-step distilled regime with FLUX.2-Klein (4B and 9B), holding its native 4-step inference path and the target prompts fixed across methods. All methods use a resolution of × 1024 1024\!\times\!1024 and the shared set of 16 content prompts. Additional visual results across generators are provided in Appendix A.3 . We compare StyleForge with five baselines: Vanilla SFT, PSO ( Miao et al., 2025 ) , D-OPSD ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) , Direct Style Extraction (DSE), and Reference-Guided Generation (RCG). For quantitative comparison, we use the VLM-based Score ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) and pairwise Win Rate ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) to assess overall style-transfer quality. The former rates each generated image from 1 to 4 according to its adherence to the target content and fidelity to the reference style, while the latter measures the proportion of direct comparisons won by a method. Both metrics are obtained from judgments by Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , and Qwen3.5-9B 1 1 1 https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.5 . The content and style tradeoff is examined through four complementary metrics in the Pareto analysis. CLIP-Text ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and VLM-F Macro ( Lan et al., 2026 ) measure content fidelity, while CLIP-Style ( Radford et al., 2021 ) and VLM-S Macro ( Lan et al., 2026 ) measure style similarity. Higher values indicate better performance for all metrics. Detailed baseline descriptions and implementation details are provided in Appendix A.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MegaStyle-1.4M（Gao 等人，2026）上评估了 StyleForge，这是一个用于风格迁移的多样化测试平台。 为了提高效率，我们随机采样了 31 种风格类别，并为每种方法在每个类别中生成 16 个场景，然后对这些场景的平均指标进行计算。 我们通过 FLUX.2-Klein（4B 和 9B）实现了少步蒸馏机制，并固定了其原生 4 步推理路径以及各方法中使用的目标提示词。 所有方法均使用 ×1024 1024\!\times\!1024 的分辨率以及共享的 16 个内容提示词集合。 不同生成器产生的更多视觉结果见附录 A.3。 我们将 StyleForge 与五种基线方法进行了比较：Vanilla SFT、PSO（Miao 等人，2025）、D-OPSD（Jiang 等人，2026a）、Direct Style Extraction（DSE）以及 Reference-Guided Generation（RCG）。 在定量比较中，我们使用基于 VLM 的 Score（Jiang 等人，2026a）和成对 Win Rate（Jiang 等人，2024）来评估整体风格迁移质量。 前者根据生成图像对目标内容的遵循程度以及对参考风格的保真度，从 1 到 4 进行评分；后者则衡量某方法在直接比较中获胜的比例。 这两种指标均通过 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct（Bai 等人，2025）以及 Qwen3.5-9B 1 1 1 https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.5 的判断获得。 在帕累托分析中，我们通过四种互补的指标来考察内容风格之间的权衡关系。 CLIP-Text（Radford 等人，2021）和 VLM-F Macro（Lan 等人，2026）用于衡量内容保真度，而 CLIP-Style（Radford 等人，2021）和 VLM-S Macro（Lan 等人，2026）则用于衡量风格相似性。 所有指标中，数值越高表示性能越好。 详细的基线方法描述及实现细节见附录 A.1。

paragraphs.en: Figures 3 and 4 present qualitative comparisons of StyleForge with baselines on FLUX.2-Klein-4B and FLUX.2-Klein-9B, respectively. paragraphs.en: Compared with StyleForge, the qualitative results highlight three issues observed in the baseline outputs. (1) Reference content leakage. DSE may introduce objects from the references that are not requested by the target prompt. For example, in Figure 3 (row 1, column 7), it generates a cyberpunk woman even though the prompt asks only for a mountain range at sunrise with a lake, clearly carrying reference content into the output. (2) Weak style preservation. Baselines often fail to retain distinctive visual cues from the references. For example, in Figure 3 (row 1, columns 3–6), D-OPSD, PSO, Vanilla SFT, and RCG render a generic sunrise landscape instead of the neon-lit metallic look of the cyberpunk references. (3) Degraded few-step generation. Adaptation-based baselines often blur outputs or lose high-frequency detail under few-step generation. For example, in Figure 3 (row 2, columns 3–5), D-OPSD, PSO, and Vanilla SFT reduce the ramen scene to diffuse orange blobs, erasing bowl edges and noodle structure. Across these cases, StyleForge better preserves reference style while keeping prompt-aligned content and clear detail under few-step generation.
paragraphs.zh: 与 StyleForge 相比，定性结果凸显了基线模型输出中观察到的三个问题。 (1) 参考内容泄露。 DSE 可能会引入参考图像中目标提示未要求的内容。 例如，在图 3（第 1 行，第 7 列）中，尽管提示仅要求生成一个日出时分的湖泊山脉，模型却生成了一个赛博朋克风格的女性，明显将参考内容带入了输出结果。 (2) 风格保留能力弱。 基线模型通常无法保留参考图像中的独特视觉特征。 例如，在图 3（第 1 行，第 3–6 列）中，D-OPSD、PSO、Vanilla SFT 和 RCG 生成的是普通的日出景观，而非赛博朋克参考图像中的霓虹灯照亮的金属质感外观。 (3) 少步生成效果退化。 基于自适应的基线模型在少步生成时常常导致输出模糊或丢失高频细节。 例如，在图 3（第 2 行，第 3–5 列）中，D-OPSD、PSO 和 Vanilla SFT 将拉面场景简化为模糊的橙色色块，抹去了碗的边缘和面条的结构。 在这些案例中，StyleForge 在少步生成下能更好地保留参考风格，同时保持与提示一致的内容和清晰的细节。

paragraphs.en: Table 4.2.2 and Figure 5 provide complementary quantitative views of style transfer. Table 4.2.2 summarizes overall transfer quality through Score and pairwise Win Rate across VLM judges and FLUX.2-Klein backbones, whereas Figure 5 evaluates the content and style tradeoff by plotting content fidelity against style similarity. The Pareto plot in Figure 5 uses the VLM-F Macro and VLM-S Macro scores judged by Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct; corresponding Pareto plots for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct and Qwen3.5-9B are provided in Appendix A.3.6 . StyleForge delivers the strongest and most balanced performance, attaining rank 1 across all settings with maximum gains over the second-best method of 29.47% in Score and 26.29% in Win Rate. Averaged across judges, the gains for the 4B backbone are 13.40% in Score and 20.77% in Win Rate, compared with 14.24% and 24.81%, respectively, for the 9B backbone. The Pareto analysis in Figure 5 places StyleForge at the Pareto frontier knee for both backbones. DSE lies toward the upper-left because reference-content leakage increases style similarity while reducing fidelity to the target content. D-OPSD lies toward the lower-right because post-training degradation blurs the background and leaves the main subject overly salient, inflating apparent content fidelity while weakening style similarity. StyleForge instead lies in the high-content, high-style region, preserving target-prompt content while transferring reference style.

paragraphs.en: This work investigated how the existing visual knowledge of step-distilled diffusion models can support reference-based style transfer without further training. To connect this knowledge with the visual characteristics of a target style, we introduced StyleForge, which expresses the interplay of rendering, color, and light as coherent guidance for image synthesis. By separating these relationships from the particular subjects and scenes in the references, the framework makes the guidance reusable as the requested content changes. This capacity to carry style across content is reflected in our evaluation, where StyleForge improves transfer quality while maintaining a strong balance between stylistic fidelity and content adherence, with the generator retaining its few-step synthesis capability. Taken together, these results highlight the importance of how style is represented when drawing on pretrained visual knowledge, and support explicit language-based guidance as a practical complement to model adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨了步数蒸馏扩散模型中现有的视觉知识如何能够在无需进一步训练的情况下支持基于参考的风格迁移。 为了将这种知识与目标风格的视觉特征联系起来，我们提出了 StyleForge，它将渲染、色彩和光线的相互作用表达为图像合成的连贯引导。 通过将这些关系与参考图像中的具体主体和场景分离，该框架使得引导能够随着所需内容的变化而重复使用。 这种跨越内容传递风格的能力体现在我们的评估结果中：StyleForge 在提升迁移质量的同时，保持了风格保真度与内容一致性之间的良好平衡，且生成器仍保留其少步数合成能力。 综合来看，这些结果凸显了利用预训练视觉知识时风格表达方式的重要性，并支持将显式的语言引导作为模型适应的实用补充。

paragraphs.en: Direct Style Extraction (DSE). A vision-language model summarizes the reference images in a natural-language style description, which is combined with the target content prompt and supplied to the generator as text.
paragraphs.zh: 直接风格提取（DSE）。 一种视觉-语言模型以自然语言风格的描述对参考图像进行总结，该描述与目标内容提示相结合，并以文本形式提供给生成器。

paragraphs.en: Reference-Guided Generation (RCG). The generator receives the reference images through its native multi-reference interface along with a text instruction to render the target content in their shared style. The reference style is conveyed jointly by image conditioning and textual guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 参考引导生成（RCG）。 生成器通过其原生多参考接口接收参考图像，同时接收一条文本指令，以在其共同风格中呈现目标内容。 参考风格由图像条件约束和文本引导共同传递。

paragraphs.en: All experiments were conducted on a server equipped with eight GPUs. We use the 4B 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B and 9B 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-9B variants of the FLUX.2-Klein text-to-image generator with their native four-step sampling procedure at a resolution of × 1024 1024\!\times\!1024 , using the same content prompts across methods. The visual style agent uses GPT-5.5 6 6 6 https://platform.openai.com/docs/models/gpt-5.5 through an OpenAI-compatible API to extract reference-style information. It should be noted that StyleForge is model-agnostic and can use other compatible vision-language models. For the trainable baselines, we train a separate LoRA adapter for each target style from the reference images on both FLUX.2-Klein backbones. D-OPSD, PSO, and vanilla SFT use the same adapter configuration, with rank r = 64 r=64 and scaling factor α = 128 \alpha=128 . Reference images are resized and center-cropped to × 1024 1024\!\times\!1024 . For each training example, the caption is randomly selected from eight English/Chinese variants, with a maximum text-sequence length of 512 tokens. We optimize the adapters with AdamW using a constant learning rate of × 10 − 5 1\!\times\!10^{-5} , ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.999) , and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} . Each adapter is trained for 1,000 optimizer updates and the total batch size is four. For D-OPSD, the student and teacher share the same frozen backbone but maintain separate LoRA adapters. The teacher adapter is initialized from the student adapter and updated after every optimizer step with an exponential moving average (EMA) decay of 0.9999. Training follows a four-step on-policy student trajectory and minimizes the mean squared error between the student and stop-gradient teacher predictions of the clean latent at each step. Vanilla SFT minimizes the latent flow-matching velocity MSE, with one timestep sampled uniformly from the model’s prescribed training timestep schedule for each example. PSO uses the same timestep sampling strategy and pairs each positive reference image with a negative image drawn from a fixed pool of 20 base-model samples per process. Positive and negative examples share the same noise, timestep, and training text condition. We use the PSO-DB objective with β = 5.0 \beta=5.0 , a negative-loss factor of 0.1, and a prior-loss weight of 0.5.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each generated image from two complementary perspectives. The first is an overall assessment of whether the image jointly satisfies the target content prompt and transfers the reference style. These results form the Score and pairwise Win Rate reported in Table 4.2.2 . The second decomposes this objective into content fidelity and style similarity for the Pareto analysis in Figure 5 . Unless stated otherwise, all statistics are computed over the same set of styles and content prompts, and larger values indicate better performance. The evaluation metrics are detailed as follows:

paragraphs.en: • Score ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) . We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct, and Qwen3.5-9B as independent judges. For each generated image, a judge receives the target content prompt and evaluates the generated image against each available reference image, using each reference only for style. The judge must assess the integrated style-transfer result rather than matching the reference content. It outputs one of four ordered labels, mapped to 1 1 – 4 4 : not consistent , slightly consistent , mostly consistent , and highly consistent . The image score is the mean of the valid per-reference scores, and the reported value is the mean over all generated images for each method and backbone. The full prompt for evaluation is given below.
paragraphs.zh: • 得分（Jiang 等人，2026a）。 我们使用 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct、Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 和 Qwen3.5-9B 作为独立的评判者。 对于每张生成的图像，每位评判者会收到目标内容提示，并依据每张可用的参考图像对生成图像进行评估，其中每张参考图像仅用于风格判断。 评判者必须评估整合后的风格迁移结果，而非与参考内容进行匹配。 其输出为四个有序标签之一，对应数值 1–4：不一致、轻微一致、基本一致和高度一致。 图像得分为每张参考图像的有效得分的平均值，而报告的值则是每种方法和每个基础模型在所有生成图像上的平均得分。 完整的评估提示词如下所示。

paragraphs.en: • Pairwise Win Rate ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) . The same VLM judges compare two candidates generated for the same target prompt. Each comparison provides a style-reference board, Candidate A, and Candidate B, and asks the judge to select the better complete style-transfer result by jointly considering content correctness and reference-style fidelity. Every unordered method pair is evaluated in both candidate orders. A win, tie, and loss contribute 1 1 , 0.5 0.5 , and 0 0 , respectively. paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 details the StyleForge pipeline for constructing reusable style instructions. Stages 1–4 expand the state integration in Eq. 1 , grounding color allocations in reference statistics, abstracting their carriers, and assigning transfer policies. Stage 5 compiles the state into a style prompt and checks its coverage and exclusion of reference content. These stages are executed once per reference set. Stage 6 reuses the validated prompt across content prompts while keeping the parameters and native few-step sampling procedure of the step-distilled T2I model fixed. This preserves the model’s native few-step generation capability.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 详细介绍了用于构建可重用风格指令的 StyleForge 流程。 第 1–4 阶段扩展了公式 1 中的状态集成，将颜色分配基于参考统计数据进行锚定，抽象其载体，并分配转移策略。 第 5 阶段将状态编译为风格提示，并检查其对参考内容的覆盖情况以及排除情况。 这些阶段对每个参考集执行一次。 第 6 阶段在内容提示中重用已验证的提示，同时保持步骤蒸馏 T2I 模型中的参数和本土少步采样流程不变。 这保留了模型原有的少步生成能力。

paragraphs.en: To complement the comparisons in Section 4.2.1 , Figure 8 presents a qualitative comparison with i2L ( Duan and Chen, 2026 ) , a feed-forward image-to-LoRA style-transfer method that predicts LoRA adapter weights directly from reference images. paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 8 , StyleForge is visually competitive with i2L across diverse styles and performs favorably on several style–content pairs. Both methods capture the cyan-lit metallic appearance of the mountain scene (row 1, left group), the monochrome lighting of the lounge (row 2, right group), and the carved black-and-white marks of the portrait (row 6, left group). In some cases, StyleForge more closely preserves specific reference characteristics. For the market scene (row 2, left group), it retains the restricted red-and-black palette, while both i2L configurations introduce multicolored fruit and flowers. For the vintage car (row 6, right group), StyleForge preserves pale watercolor washes and soft transitions, while i2L at CFG=4 produces more saturated colors and stronger outlines. These examples illustrate that StyleForge can achieve competitive reference-style fidelity through textual guidance while retaining few-step generation. More generally, the side-by-side examples provide a convenient visual check of palette, illumination, surface treatment, and edge rendering across different content prompts. By placing each reference beside outputs for the same content prompt, the comparison exposes whether a method transfers these reference-specific properties while preserving the requested content, including distinctions that aggregate quantitative scores may obscure.

paragraphs.en: To examine whether StyleForge’s extracted style representation transfers beyond the FLUX.2-Klein family, we first reuse the same rendering instructions with Z-Image-Turbo 6B 9 9 9 https://huggingface.co/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo , a few-step distilled generator. Z-Image-Turbo does not support reference-image conditioning, so RCG is not applicable and is omitted from Figure 9 . StyleForge is therefore evaluated through its extracted textual instructions. The results preserve recognizable palette structure, contrast, and lighting cues across the requested subjects, indicating that the extracted description remains effective when the generator changes. Z-Image-Turbo appears somewhat less consistent in following explicit hexadecimal color specifications than the FLUX.2-Klein series, so its overall color control is slightly less precise. This difference is best understood as a property of the generator’s conditioning behavior and does not prevent the broader rendering style from transferring. We then apply the same instructions to the efficient closed-source systems GPT-Image-2.5-Flare 10 10 10 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-image-2.5-flare and Nano-Banana-2-Lite 11 11 11 https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation . Figure 11 shows that GPT-Image-2.5-Flare follows the extracted style cues across portraits, objects, and scenes while adapting them to different content prompts. The results in Figure 11 provide a similar observation for Nano-Banana-2-Lite. Consistent style transfer on a distilled generator and two efficient closed-source systems suggests that StyleForge captures reusable textual style descriptions rather than generator-specific visual features.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验 StyleForge 提取的风格表示能否迁移到 FLUX.2-Klein 系列之外的模型，我们首先使用相同的渲染指令与 Z-Image-Turbo 6B 9 9 9 https://huggingface.co/Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo（一个经过少步蒸馏的生成器）进行实验。 Z-Image-Turbo 不支持参考图像条件约束，因此 RCG 不适用，且未包含在图 9 中。 因此，StyleForge 是通过其提取的文本指令进行评估的。 结果在不同请求主题中保留了可识别的色彩搭配结构、对比度和光照线索，表明当生成器发生变化时，提取的描述仍然有效。 Z-Image-Turbo 在遵循明确的十六进制颜色规范方面似乎比 FLUX.2-Klein 系列稍差一些，因此其整体色彩控制也略微不够精确。 这种差异最好被理解为生成器条件约束行为的特性，并不会阻碍更广泛的渲染风格的迁移。 接着，我们将相同的指令应用于高效的闭源系统 GPT-Image-2.5-Flare 10 10 10 https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-image-2.5-flare 和 Nano-Banana-2-Lite 11 11 11 https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/image-generation。 图 11 显示，GPT-Image-2.5-Flare 在肖像、物体和场景中都遵循了提取的风格线索，同时根据不同的内容提示进行了调整。 图 11 中的结果对 Nano-Banana-2-Lite 也得出了类似的观察结论。 在蒸馏生成器和两个高效的闭源系统上实现了一致的风格迁移，这表明 StyleForge 捕捉的是可重用的文本风格描述，而非特定于生成器的视觉特征。

paragraphs.en: Prior work such as D-OPSD ( Jiang et al., 2026a ) studies subject driven generation together with style transfer. In this work, we focus on transferring visual style to new content and treat subject driven generation as a related but separate setting. This scope is motivated by the capabilities of modern step-distilled T2I models: subject driven generation is already a strong native capability. Given a small set of reference images, these models can preserve the identities and fine visual details of multiple subjects while composing them in a new scene. We include the following example to illustrate this native capability and to clarify the distinction between these two uses of reference images. Figure 12 gives a qualitative illustration. We provide three reference images, showing a can, a toy car, and a berry bowl, and ask the model to place all three subjects in a new cinematic mountain-road scene. With the references, the generated image retains the identities and salient details of all three objects: the can’s blue color, graphics, and lettering, the toy car’s red-and-green body, driver, and antenna, and the bowl’s shape, grid pattern, and handwritten text. The generated scene also composes these objects into the requested interaction, including the collision, trailer, and flying berries. For comparison, the text-only sample produced with the same prompt and seed contains different instances of the objects and does not preserve their reference-specific appearance. The example shows how reference images can preserve subject identity and fine details, while our main setting uses references to transfer rendering behavior across different content.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究，例如 D-OPSD（Jiang 等人，2026a），探讨了主题驱动生成与风格迁移的结合。 在本研究中，我们专注于将视觉风格迁移到新内容中，并将主题驱动生成视为一个相关但独立的场景。 这一研究范围源于现代步蒸馏 T2I 模型的能力：主题驱动生成本身已是一项强大的原生功能。 给定一组参考图像，这些模型能够在合成新场景的同时，保留多个主体的身份特征和精细视觉细节。 我们提供以下示例来说明这一原生能力，并明确这两种参考图像使用方式的区别。 图 12 提供了定性说明。 我们提供了三张参考图像，分别展示了一个罐头、一辆玩具车和一碗浆果，并要求模型将这三个主体置于一个新的电影感山间公路场景中。 借助这些参考图像，生成的图像保留了所有三个物体的身份特征和显著细节：罐头的蓝色外观、图案和文字，玩具车的红绿车身、驾驶员和天线，以及碗的形状、网格图案和手写文字。 生成的场景还将这些物体按照要求进行了组合，包括碰撞、拖尾和浆果飞溅等效果。 作为对比，使用相同提示词和种子生成的纯文本样本包含了不同实例的物体，并未保留其参考图像中的特定外观。 该示例展示了参考图像如何保留主题身份和精细细节，而我们的主要场景则利用参考图像在不同内容间迁移渲染行为。

paragraphs.en: This section presents the structured prompt used by StyleForge for the VLM-facing extraction stage, which converts multiple reference images into an initial reusable style descriptor. The prompt directs the vision-language model to identify only shared, content-agnostic rendering traits, organize them by the enabled style axes, and return a strict JSON descriptor together with a generator-facing style fragment. Reference-specific subjects, objects, and one-off scene details are explicitly excluded so that the extracted style can be applied to new content. The returned descriptor is subsequently integrated with color and luminance statistics and mapped to the rendering, color-and-light, composition, and reference-content components of the StyleForge state.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了 StyleForge 在面向 VLM 的提取阶段所使用的结构化提示，该提示可将多个参考图像转换为可重复使用的初始风格描述符。 该提示指导视觉语言模型仅识别共享的、与内容无关的渲染特征，按启用的风格轴对其进行组织，并返回一个严格的 JSON 描述符以及一个面向生成器的风格片段。 明确排除了参考图像中的特定主体、物体和一次性场景细节，以便提取出的风格能够应用于新内容。 随后，返回的描述符将与颜色和亮度统计量进行整合，并映射到 StyleForge 状态中的渲染、颜色与光照、构图以及参考内容组件。

sents.en: This section presents the structured prompt used by StyleForge for the VLM-facing extraction stage, which converts multiple reference images into an initial reusable style descriptor.
sents.zh: 本节介绍了 StyleForge 在面向 VLM 的提取阶段所使用的结构化提示，该提示可将多个参考图像转换为可重复使用的初始风格描述符。

sents.en: The prompt directs the vision-language model to identify only shared, content-agnostic rendering traits, organize them by the enabled style axes, and return a strict JSON descriptor together with a generator-facing style fragment.
sents.zh: 该提示指导视觉语言模型仅识别共享的、与内容无关的渲染特征，按启用的风格轴对其进行组织，并返回一个严格的 JSON 描述符以及一个面向生成器的风格片段。

sents.en: Reference-specific subjects, objects, and one-off scene details are explicitly excluded so that the extracted style can be applied to new content.
sents.zh: 明确排除了参考图像中的特定主体、物体和一次性场景细节，以便提取出的风格能够应用于新内容。

sents.en: The returned descriptor is subsequently integrated with color and luminance statistics and mapped to the rendering, color-and-light, composition, and reference-content components of the StyleForge state.
sents.zh: 随后，返回的描述符将与颜色和亮度统计量进行整合，并映射到 StyleForge 状态中的渲染、颜色与光照、构图以及参考内容组件。
